info.title: AIOManager integration API
info.description: Application 2.0.0. All timestamps are Unix milliseconds; membership also includes local wall time and IANA timezone. HTTPS is required for remote use. No billing or IPTV operations. Persist each mutation intent/key before sending. Poll jobs until verified; failed is not proof of no external effect.

offset.description: UTC offset in minutes; supply to disambiguate a repeated local time.
